covenantTerms: Owner-occupancy as primary residence required. Subletting limited to 12 months with trust approval. Resale only to income-eligible buyers at or below the formula price; the trust holds a right of first refusal. Monthly ground lease fee of $45, adjusted every five years.

Owner-occupancy as primary residence required. Resale price follows the change in CPI from the purchase date; capital improvements are credited up to the cap with trust pre-approval. The trust holds a right of first refusal. Monthly ground lease fee of $40.

Owner-occupancy as primary residence required. Resale price follows the change in area median income, keeping homes affordable to the same income band. The trust holds a right of first refusal. Monthly ground lease fee of $35.

Owner-occupancy as primary residence required. Resale price grows by a fixed 2% of the original purchase price per year of ownership. The trust holds a right of first refusal. Monthly ground lease fee of $45.
Owner-occupancy as primary residence required. Resale only to income-eligible buyers at or below the formula price. Superseded by the standard 99-year lease; kept for leases signed before 2024.
